title: Lidar Inertial Odometry and Mapping for Autonomous Vehicle in GPS-Denied Parking Lot
authors: Chen X.; Zhang S.; Wu J.; He R.; Song S.; Zhu B.; Zhao J.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
